newsitem.title: USA: Dow rallies after NAPM decline, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rallies after NAPM decline, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks rushed higher after a decline in the National Association of Purchasing Managers report for June calmed financial markets' inflation fears before a Federal Reserve policy maker meeting.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up around 49 points at 7722, after the New York Stock Exchange set trading curbs.
The long bond was up 12/32 at a 6.76 percent yield.
The Nasdaq composite rose 0.93 points to 1443.
The June NAPM index showed a 55.7 reading versus 57.1 in May. Analysts had said a sharp rise might have signaled manufacturing strength, raising fears about a rate hike.
